title: Filler: Sakura's Quiz
later: Study session later! You look busy. Don't think you're getting out of it, though.

offer.speaker: sakura
offer.text: Hey, new kid! The exam isn't just throwing kunai, you know. There's theory. Lots of it.

offer.speaker: sakura
offer.text: Let's see if you've been listening to Iruka-sensei. Quiz time!

dialogue.speaker: sakura
dialogue.text: Question one: which three jutsu does the graduation exam test?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Correct! See, you HAVE been listening.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Those are chakra natures! Wrong exam, years too early.

dialogue.speaker: sakura
dialogue.text: Question two: what is chakra made of?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: ...Have you been spending time with Naruto?

dialogue.speaker: sakura
dialogue.text: Not bad! Sasuke would've got them all, of course. ...Don't tell him I said that.
